asr.full_text: Music Bone tumor is a fatal disease. After this disease, mostly patients die within 9 to 12 months. Only 3 percent of people can live for more than 3 years. No one knows the reason behind brain tumour however one can find out from research there are few issues that can cause it. Some medical researchers have developed ways to treat this condition. In today's health mantra video we will talk to you on this serious topic and tell you all the ways to tackle this. So let us first understand this condition. However, due to wrong behaviour of human, many new cells grow opposite the physical condition to their natural needs The body which does not need these old or active cells does not die These fake cells often turns into tissue which is called a tumor Brain tumor can be a kind of heart attack. When soft cancer is more common, it increases the pressure of the liver. Due to this, the brain can become damaged. The brain tumour is kept in the second category. Primary brain tumour is present in the brain? Many primary brain tumours become soft, while in secondary brain tumours, cancer attacks spread in our brain through a certain organ of the body. Such as the lungs and the breasts. Such secondary brain tumours are also known as metastatic brain tumours. What are the symptoms of Braintumour. Every part of our brain controls any special function. When in a particular part of our brain controls some specific work! When the brain is in some particular part there is a tumor. So this affects the activities involved in that part of the body. Let's understand it a bit more in detail. If the brain is a tumor in stem, then the walking, seeing things, difficulty at swallowing, speaking and closing of the eyes, leads to problems such as lack of coordination. When cancer cells are formed in the cerebellum, Problems of difficulty in swallowing, speech and poor coordination of the eyes arise. Cancer symptoms can lead to malnutrition, and face problems similar to a pain in neck. In the case of the terminal lobe, the tumour can make speech difficult, memory failure & unmeasured fear, black out & a strange smell. Facing cancer can be limited to Occipital lobe. Facing a periorital lobe can cause a tumor to be created or the problems of reading, writing, calculating, navigating, weakness on one hand in the body and problems of understanding words can be caused. Faking tumour in the frontal lobe causes area, by having tumor in frontal lobe, there are people with weak physical stability, developmental changes and problem of smell getting recognized. What are the causes of Brain Tumor? By the way, the problem of brain tumor is not a specific one. Some of the changes caused by genes are the main cause of some types of tumours. There is still a debate over the radiation emitted from mobile mobile gadgets such as mobile phones along with brain tumours. But it has not been proven yet. Like other tumours, Brain tumors are not infectious in which the infection cannot spread in others. How to cure brain tumor ? To cure brain tumor doctor asks about the symptoms and history of personal and family as well as. Then a neurological examination is done. Instead of paying attention to an indicator of the brain tumor, the doctor can conduct an image scan of the brain from the CT scan or MRI to examine a brain image to see signs of a blood clot type in the brain in her eyes. Also, to determine if there's cancer or not, a doctor can also get her biopsy. What is the treatment for Brain Tumour? Well, in general, surgery is the first option Brain Tumor? To eliminate Tumor, Surgery is usually the first option but sometimes tumor is at one point of Cognitive disorder where it is difficult to perform Surgery. In such cases chemotherapy and radiation therapy can be one of the options. Sometimes for curing some remaining cancer, chemotherapy or radiation can be a solution to getting sick In case of trying to fight a cancer after surgery chemotherapy or radiation can be used After these his recovery must be covered with physical, occupational and speech therapy For some brain tumours being cured can be a huge hurt However, you could share your share your feelings with your doctor with honest. brain tumor treatment team is excellent in terms of skills, knowledge and experience, so trust them and get rid of brain tumor. to watch more interesting videos like this, do not forget to SUBSCRIBE to our channel health Mantra.
